page: Microsoft Azure L12aos_v5 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Laosv5 family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this server features 12 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and does not include integrated graphics processing units.

A key hardware feature of the L12aos_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, providing 8640 GB of local storage. The instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, making it suitable for secure backend deployments.

Given the high local storage capacity and the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for data-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large relational databases, NoSQL databases, data warehousing, and big data analytics. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, while the high resource density of both memory and local storage provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive local scratch space or high-throughput database operations without the overhead of external storage latency.
